items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My best recollection is that there was a Dr. Morton-Finney at Attucks.

ctx.x: While we’re there, let me just ask you something about [something else]. We were talking last night. Was Dr. [John] Morton-Finney already at Attucks [Crispus Attucks High School in Indianapolis] when you were there?
My best recollection is that there was a Dr. Morton-Finney at Attucks.
He’s 104 years old now and still practicing law. I saw it in the Star [Indianapolis Star newspaper] yesterday.
